basis: B52 (P-334 (5)); moved from api/src/own-yes-no.ts to data by B88 (P-319). Per combination, the application form whose Yes/No form fields worked out from other answers are each asked as their own question, in the form's words: IMM 5257 (09-2023) p. 1 Question 2 A "Have you ever used any other name such as a nickname, maiden name or alias?"; p. 2 "Do you have a national identity document?"; p. 2 "Are you a lawful Permanent Resident of the United States with a valid alien registration card (green card)?". The library field of the same name is used when there is one (IMM 0008's and IMM 1294's field maps name them so). Sample, Unconfirmed: expert. B116 (founder's ruling on #1123, 6 Nov 2026: the product fills every box Validate insists on, never a hand tick): three form fields no saved AI answer mapped are asked too, for every applicant, minors included, in the form's words: Background information Question 1 a) "Within the past two years, have you or a family member ever had tuberculosis of the lungs or been in close contact with a person with tuberculosis?"; Question 6 "Have you ever witnessed or participated in the ill treatment of prisoners or civilians, looting or desecration of religious buildings?"; the consent "Do you consent to be contacted by CIC, or an organization at CIC's request, in the future?" (its reading prints Question 6's caption on that box, so the question is quoted from the form's saved text, prototype/expected/source-text/imm5257e.xfa-template.txt). IMM 5257's own Validate stops on each when it is empty (tech lead's Validate, 6 Nov ~03:20 IST). For now the three B116 boxes are asked by the configured checkpoint only ("checkpointOnly"; tech lead's ruling on #1123, 6 Nov ~07:2x IST, the founder's choice (a)): asking them on the six moves Visitor visa's question list off vv.single-ae2133b8a398, which the six's saved AI pairs (conditions 83a49fd2, PQR picks fc52039a) read, and a paid re-run on the new list (6 Nov, US$0.56) no longer proposed the conditions B114 and B88 are built on. Adding them to the six with a better-checked paid run is a hardening item. QA-165 (tech lead's brief, 8 Nov 2026; diagnosis on #1256): "followUps" lists, per Yes/No box, the questions the form asks only after a Yes. Each pair is the form's own, never guessed (AGENTS rule 4): the box's field map derivation names one of them (IMM 5257 (09-2023): "derived:any(person.other_family_name, person.other_given_names) recorded", "derived:person.national_id_number recorded", "derived:valid person.us_green_card_number recorded"), and every other one is a form field inside the Yes/No box's own block of the form (AliasName[0], natID[0].natIDdocs[0], USCard[0].usCarddocs[0]); the configured checkpoint's step 230 refuses any follow-up that is neither. The checkpoint gives each the question condition "show only when <the Yes/No question> is Yes" (Questionnaires › the question's condition), so a No hides them and writes N. QA-165's last two (tech lead, Lead 35, on #1363, 8 Nov 2026): IMM 5257's Passport Question 5 (Taiwan PIN) and Question 6 (National Israeli passport) are Yes/No form fields nothing fills, which the form's own script requires only for one country or territory of issue (samples/form-script-requirements.json, CR 330212: code 203, "TWN (Taiwan)", and 206, "ISR (Israel)", in the form's own country list). Each is asked as its own question in the form's words (quoted from its saved text, page 2), checkpointOnly as B116's, and "askedWhen" gives it the question condition "show only when the passport's country or territory of issue is <that one>": the configured checkpoint's step 230 sets it only when the form's script names that condition for that form field (askedWhenGround), so for any other passport neither is asked nor written.

boxes.label: Has used other name
boxes.meaning: Whether the person has ever used any other name, such as a nickname, maiden name or alias (IMM 5257 p. 1, Question 2 A).

boxes.label: Has national ID
boxes.meaning: Whether the person has a national identity document (IMM 5257 p. 2, National identity document, Question 1).

boxes.label: US permanent resident
boxes.meaning: Whether the person is a lawful permanent resident of the United States with a valid alien registration card (green card) (IMM 5257 p. 2, US PR card, Question 1).

boxes.label: Tuberculosis in past two years
boxes.meaning: Whether, within the past two years, the person or a family member has had tuberculosis of the lungs or been in close contact with a person with tuberculosis (IMM 5257, Background information, Question 1 a).

boxes.label: Ill treatment of prisoners or civilians
boxes.meaning: Whether the person has ever witnessed or participated in the ill treatment of prisoners or civilians, looting or desecration of religious buildings (IMM 5257, Background information, Question 6).

boxes.label: Consents to research contact
boxes.meaning: Whether the person consents to be contacted in the future by IRCC (CIC on the form), or an organization at its request, about the services they received, for research, performance measurement or evaluation; never used to decide about them (IMM 5257, consent before the signature).
boxes.question: Do you consent to be contacted by CIC, or an organization at CIC’s request, in the future?

boxes.label: Taiwan passport with personal ID number

boxes.question: For this trip, will you use a passport issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Taiwan that includes your personal identification number?

boxes.label: National Israeli passport
